description: Matches every region value against the template's geography and reports unmatched values with the closest real codes, how many regions would stay grey, and the scale the map would use. No key needed. Use it when unsure of the codes; then create_from_template with the same data and knobs.

data.description: The data you intend to send

dateFormat.description: For date columns whose strings are NOT ISO-ish: a strftime-style parse hint tried first — tokens %Y %m %d %b %B %q %H %M %S, e.g. "%d/%m/%Y" for "15/03/2024", "%b %Y" for "Mar 2024". Removes the day/month guess; ISO-ish strings never need it.

type.description: date columns parse ISO-ish strings on their own: "2024", "2024-03", "2024-03-15", "2024-Q2", full ISO timestamps, or epoch numbers. Anything else needs dateFormat.

rows.description: Row-major values, one array per row, order matching columns

template.description: Template id, slug, or page address (sweden/municipalities)

name: check_template_data
title: Dry run: would this data and these knobs work with the template? Creates nothing
